novel_features.name: Compliance Audit
novel_features.description: Surface every employee below a completion threshold, grouped by role — the Monday compliance check in one command.

novel_features.name: Assignment Gap Detector
novel_features.description: Detect users missing subject assignments that peers in their role have — catch forgotten onboarding assignments before managers complain.

novel_features.name: Content Quality Audit
novel_features.description: List all curriculums with course counts, test counts, and enrollment — flag empty, untested, and orphaned content in one table.

novel_features.name: Onboarding Progress Tracker
novel_features.description: Show new hires from the last N days with their assignment completeness and completion percentage, grouped by role.

novel_features.name: Training Coverage Matrix
novel_features.description: Produce a role-by-subject matrix showing completion percentage per cell — the exact report ops managers build by hand in Excel.

novel_features.name: Role Completion Leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank roles by average completion percentage — instantly see which venues or teams are ahead or behind.

novel_features.name: Completion Trend Tracker
novel_features.description: Show how a user's completion percentage has changed over successive syncs — week-over-week training progress.

novel_features.name: Bulk Role-Based Assignment
novel_features.description: Assign subjects to all users in a role with one command — the role-based fan-out that individual assign-subjects can't do.
